summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing for KORIX premium landing (layered hero + Mission + Portfolio embla carousel + Process + FinalCTA with planet bg). All 12 requested feature areas verified end-to-end on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). 100% pass, no console or page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx still hardcodes '© 2024 Korix' — current month is Jan 2026; consider `new Date().getFullYear()` for the copyright year (carried over from iteration 1, not blocking).

Mission/Services hover transforms use `hover:-translate-y-1` on the inner div which sits inside a framer-motion Reveal wrapper — works fine but stacking the transforms can occasionally fight on slow machines; not observed during testing.
All social icons in Footer link to '#contact' instead of real social URLs (intentional for static MVP, but flag for production handover).
